hypothesis: Train and freeze a task-agnostic recurrent SMILES next-token prior, then build a fresh reward-backed prefix tree for each objective: seed prefix statistics from the scored initial molecules, select branches by a prior-guided upper-confidence rule, expand an unseen likely token, complete it by recurrent rollout, and backpropagate each returned oracle score through the proposal's prefix path so subsequent de novo construction balances exploitation of valuable prefixes with exploration of under-visited branches.
method_name: ChemTS-style RNN-guided Monte Carlo tree search
method_thesis: Train a task-agnostic recurrent next-token model on the allowed unlabeled SMILES corpus and freeze it as a chemical-language prior. For each independent objective session, grow a fresh Monte Carlo search tree whose nodes are SMILES prefixes: initialize available path statistics from the ten scored starting molecules, select prefixes by an upper-confidence tree rule, expand them with high-probability unseen tokens from the frozen model, and use model rollouts to complete new molecules. Canonicalize locally and submit batches containing only newly constructed, valid, unique terminal SMILES; after each oracle response, backpropagate the observed scores through the visited prefix paths. The dynamically expanded tree therefore converts 290 feedback calls into increasingly focused de novo construction toward high terminal rewards without updating a policy, fitting a latent surrogate, mutating evaluated parent graphs, or ranking a finite corpus pool.

method_tags.learning_mechanism: offline next-token model training plus online backpropagation of observed rewards into prefix visit counts and values
method_tags.proposal_mechanism: upper-confidence prefix selection, prior-guided token expansion, and recurrent rollouts to de novo terminal SMILES
method_tags.representation: tokenized SMILES prefixes with a frozen recurrent chemical-language prior

activation_observables.measurement: For every suggestion round, report the fraction of emitted canonical molecules whose recorded generation trace contains a UCT-selected prefix, one newly expanded token edge, and a terminal recurrent rollout, together with counts for each missing trace component relative to a zero-trace baseline.
activation_observables.name: traceable_tree_expansion_rollout_rate

activation_observables.measurement: After each observe message, report the fraction of accepted scored proposals whose complete recorded root-to-expansion path had every node's visit count and return sum updated by that proposal's oracle score, plus the mean number of updated prefix nodes per accepted proposal.
activation_observables.name: oracle_reward_backpropagation_coverage

activation_observables.measurement: For each post-feedback suggestion round, report the fraction of competitive tree-selection decisions at which at least one eligible child had oracle-backed value statistics and the chosen child was determined using the exploitation term as well as the exploration term; compare this rate between the first and second halves of the objective session.
activation_observables.name: reward_informed_uct_selection_rate

activation_observables.measurement: At UCT decisions where the selected child and at least one alternative both have oracle-backed returns, log the selected child's empirical mean downstream reward minus the visit-weighted mean for the eligible alternatives, then aggregate the signed difference by feedback round.
activation_observables.name: selected_prefix_value_advantage

activation_observables.measurement: Hash the recurrent prior state immediately after loading and at session shutdown and report the maximum absolute parameter difference observed across the session; both hashes must match and the numeric drift must be zero.
activation_observables.name: frozen_recurrent_prior_parameter_drift

activation_observables.measurement: For every suggestion round, report unique valid canonical molecules emitted per completed tree rollout, with invalid terminals, already evaluated molecules, prior emitted duplicates, and within-batch collisions counted separately.
activation_observables.name: novel_valid_tree_rollout_yield

applicability_conditions: The unlabeled corpus supports a recurrent SMILES prior with enough valid and novel rollout yield to fill every announced batch within the proposal-attempt limit.
The ten fixed initial molecules and subsequent scored completions provide token-prefix paths that can initialize and progressively expand a useful search tree.
High-reward molecules share prefix-level sequence regularities with reachable descendants, so backed-up terminal rewards provide useful selection information despite SMILES representation dependence.
The batchwise feedback schedule supplies enough selection, expansion, rollout, and backpropagation cycles for reward-informed UCT decisions to occur within the 300-call objective session.

The method may underperform when useful structures require prefix branches assigned negligible probability by the frozen recurrent prior or when alternative SMILES for related chemistry fragment reward evidence across unrelated token paths.
research_intent.falsifier: The root mechanism is falsified if accepted post-initial proposals cannot be traced to UCT selection, unseen-token expansion, and recurrent rollout, if returned oracle scores do not update their recorded prefix paths, or if oracle-backed prefix values never participate in a later competitive UCT selection decision.
research_intent.implementation_change: Implement prepare mode to tokenize the unlabeled corpus, train a recurrent next-token SMILES model, and publish its vocabulary, configuration, and weights. Implement run mode to seed every RNG from init, load that model as an immutable prior on logical cuda:0, initialize a task-local token-prefix trie from the canonicalized scored initial observations, generate each evaluator-announced batch through UCT selection, prior-guided token expansion, and recurrent terminal rollout, canonicalize locally while excluding invalid and previously proposed molecules, retain an emitted-molecule-to-prefix-path trace, and update visit counts and downstream return statistics along each accepted path after every observe message without optimizing the recurrent model.
research_intent.mechanism: Train and freeze a task-agnostic recurrent SMILES next-token prior, then build a fresh reward-backed prefix tree for each objective: seed prefix statistics from the scored initial molecules, select branches by a prior-guided upper-confidence rule, expand an unseen likely token, complete it by recurrent rollout, and backpropagate each returned oracle score through the proposal's prefix path so subsequent de novo construction balances exploitation of valuable prefixes with exploration of under-visited branches.
research_intent.observed_bottleneck: With only 290 adaptive oracle calls after the ten fixed initial molecules, a de novo optimizer must preserve enough chemical validity and exploration to keep filling batches while making sparse, delayed batch feedback influence later proposals; unguided sampling from a frozen language model would not focus on high-reward regions, whereas repeatedly changing the model weights can dilute an exceptional terminal reward across many unrelated sequences.

applicability_conditions: The corpus supported training and loading a task-agnostic recurrent prior in this configuration: preparation used 160,000 sequences with a 70-token vocabulary and produced the two receipted artifact files.
The fixed initial panel supported tree initialization on all evaluated objectives: every task log reports 10 seeded initial paths, 0 skipped paths, and root visit count 10.

Oracle feedback supplied usable prefix statistics during the observed early rounds: 390/390 accepted proposals were completely backed up, 1,173/1,250 competitive selections used unequal oracle-backed child means, and the aggregate selected-prefix value advantage was positive.
The frozen-prior condition is supported through each observed task failure: all five sessions report zero parameter drift and identical load/shutdown hashes.

Sustained applicability under the full 300-call, batch-10 protocol is not supported. The five sessions terminated after only 4-11 completed adaptive rounds and 50-120 total oracle calls because the next batch could not be filled within 2,500 rollouts.

The evidence supports early operation only where high-value descendants remain reachable through the prior's top-ranked token branches and novelty does not collapse under canonicalization; it does not establish transfer to later search phases, low-prior branches, or objectives whose related structures occupy disconnected SMILES prefixes.
Evidence is limited to screening seed 0, and the exact per-emitted-molecule non-root UCT-prefix trace rate plus the planned late-half selection trend remain unmeasured by the current telemetry.

observable_measurements.parent_value: No Parent Algorithm Node exists for this lineage root. Under the zero-tree reference there are zero competitive UCT decisions with oracle-backed unequal child values, hence reward-informed rate 0.0.
observable_measurements.value: The completed rounds logged 1,173 reward-informed decisions among 1,250 competitive tree-selection decisions, a pooled rate of 0.9384 above the zero-tree reference. No task reached round 15, so the pre-registered comparison between the first and second halves of a complete 29-round adaptive objective session is unavailable. Lines 631-650 show that the chosen-child score includes empirical mean reward and exploration and count a decision as reward-informed when eligible child means differ; the log does not record the counterfactual exploration-only argmax.

observable_measurements.name: novel_valid_tree_rollout_yield
observable_measurements.parent_value: No Parent Algorithm Node exists for this lineage root. Relative to a no-tree reference, successful rounds have positive novel-valid rollout yield, but there is no parent-node yield measurement and the evidence does not support sustained batch-filling yield.
observable_measurements.value: For the 39 successfully emitted batches, 390 unique valid canonical molecules were produced from 606 completed tree rollouts, giving the pre-registered completed-rollout yield 0.6435643564356436. The logs separately account for 216 invalid completed terminals and 133 incomplete rollouts among 739 raw rollouts; evaluated-molecule collisions, prior-emission collisions, and within-batch collisions were all zero in those completed batches. The implementation's logged raw-rollout denominator gives 390/739 = 0.5277401894451962, while per-round completed-conditioned yield ranged from 0.4166666666666667 to 1.0. Operational yield then collapsed: each task's next suggestion attempt hit the 2,500-rollout ceiling after finding only 8, 9, 9, 7, and 7 of the required 10 candidates respectively, so no task completed the 300-call session. Those five failure paths raise before the activation record, leaving their completed-rollout, invalid-terminal, and collision breakdowns unmeasured; finalization confirms the 40 partial candidates through emitted-set counts.

possible_failure_causes: Novel-valid support deteriorated as the persistent tree grew: successful completed-rollout yield was 0.6435643564356436 overall, and every task later found only 7-9 batch candidates within 2,500 raw rollouts.

The hand-written token legality rules and top-20 recurrent rollout restriction can enter chemically invalid or unterminated prefixes; even successful rounds recorded 216 invalid terminals and 133 incomplete rollouts.

Canonical, already-evaluated, and previously emitted collisions at lines 819-827 are rejected without increasing invalid_rollouts or marking the responsible branch dead, so repeated equivalent SMILES may consume the fixed attempt allowance once novel support narrows; failure-round counters are absent, so this remains a possible rather than demonstrated cause.

Progressive widening considers at most the 18 highest-ranked legal actions and UCT repeatedly descends value-favored prefixes, which may exhaust reachable novel molecules when reward evidence is fragmented across alternative SMILES paths.

The failed-batch diagnostic is placed after the completeness exception, preventing attribution of the terminal collapse among invalid, incomplete, evaluated, prior-emitted, and within-batch collision categories and preventing measurement of a full-session first-versus-second-half trend.

applicability_conditions: The unlabeled corpus supports a recurrent SMILES prior with enough valid and novel rollout yield to fill every announced batch within the proposal-attempt limit.
The ten fixed initial molecules and subsequent scored completions provide token-prefix paths that can initialize and progressively expand a useful search tree.
High-reward molecules share prefix-level sequence regularities with reachable descendants, so backed-up terminal rewards provide useful selection information despite SMILES representation dependence.
The batchwise feedback schedule supplies enough selection, expansion, rollout, and backpropagation cycles for reward-informed UCT decisions to occur within the 300-call objective session.

The method may underperform when useful structures require prefix branches assigned negligible probability by the frozen recurrent prior or when alternative SMILES for related chemistry fragment reward evidence across unrelated token paths.
research_intent.falsifier: The root mechanism is falsified if accepted post-initial proposals cannot be traced to UCT selection, unseen-token expansion, and recurrent rollout, if returned oracle scores do not update their recorded prefix paths, or if oracle-backed prefix values never participate in a later competitive UCT selection decision.
research_intent.implementation_change: Implement prepare mode to tokenize the unlabeled corpus, train a recurrent next-token SMILES model, and publish its vocabulary, configuration, and weights. Implement run mode to seed every RNG from init, load that model as an immutable prior on logical cuda:0, initialize a task-local token-prefix trie from the canonicalized scored initial observations, generate each evaluator-announced batch through UCT selection, prior-guided token expansion, and recurrent terminal rollout, canonicalize locally while excluding invalid and previously proposed molecules, retain an emitted-molecule-to-prefix-path trace, and update visit counts and downstream return statistics along each accepted path after every observe message without optimizing the recurrent model.
research_intent.mechanism: Train and freeze a task-agnostic recurrent SMILES next-token prior, then build a fresh reward-backed prefix tree for each objective: seed prefix statistics from the scored initial molecules, select branches by a prior-guided upper-confidence rule, expand an unseen likely token, complete it by recurrent rollout, and backpropagate each returned oracle score through the proposal's prefix path so subsequent de novo construction balances exploitation of valuable prefixes with exploration of under-visited branches.
research_intent.observed_bottleneck: With only 290 adaptive oracle calls after the ten fixed initial molecules, a de novo optimizer must preserve enough chemical validity and exploration to keep filling batches while making sparse, delayed batch feedback influence later proposals; unguided sampling from a frozen language model would not focus on high-reward regions, whereas repeatedly changing the model weights can dilute an exceptional terminal reward across many unrelated sequences.
